status: experimental interoperability profile; no production promotion
purpose: Normalize privacy-preserving or independently verifiable external assertions into bounded evidence inputs without making any proof system, blockchain, credential format, or verifier a source of ambient authority.
core_distinctions: proof verifies != claim is globally true
proof verifies != subject identity is universally established
proof verifies != currentness outside the checked freshness window
verifier_transparency: verifier identity and implementation digest are recorded
trust anchors or verifier profile are explicit
independent reproducibility is recorded rather than assumed
opaque proof semantics may remain advisory but cannot silently satisfy a trust-critical institutional proof requirement
interoperability_rule: AXIOM integrates proof systems through adapters. Verification output is normalized into a claim-specific evidence result; local policy separately decides whether that evidence is sufficient for the requested consequence.
privacy_rule: Prefer proving the narrowest predicate needed for the decision rather than transferring the underlying sensitive record.
offline_rule: An assertion whose required verifier, revocation source, or trust anchor cannot be refreshed offline must retain its recorded validity window; offline operation may not silently extend it.
nonclaims: This profile does not implement zero-knowledge cryptography.
This profile does not endorse or require PulseChain, ProveX, ZKP2P, zkTLS, any credential standard, or any blockchain.
A valid proof-bearing assertion grants no execution authority by itself.
A verifier result is bounded to the exact statement and bindings checked.
